name: usage-band
description: Always-visible band above the Claude Code prompt: your 5-hour and 7-day limits, how much of each window has passed, and when each resets. Free, local, terminal and desktop.

colorMode.title: Color mode
colorMode.description: level: each limit turns green, amber or red with its percentage. fixed: each limit keeps its own color.
